label: EntityDescriptor (Root element)
help: The root element of a SAML metadata document must be EntityDescriptor.

label: RegistrationInfo
help: RegistrationInfo must not be set; it will be added by SURFconext

label: SPSSODescriptor
help: SPSSODescriptor is required for Service Provider metadata.

label: AssertionConsumerService
help: AssertionConsumerService is where the IdP sends the SAML Response.

label: UIInfo (Discovery metadata)
help: A <md:UIInfo> element is required.  It contains information for display in discovery services (e.g., Logo, DisplayName).

label: Organization info
help: A <md:Organization> element with information about the origanization whick provides the service.

label: OrganizationName
help: The Organization element needs to contain the element <md:OrganizationName xml:lang="en">.  Other languages are optional.

label: OrganizationDisplayName
help: The Organization element needs to contain the element <md:OrganizationDisplayName xml:lang="en">. Other languages are optional.

label: OrganizationURL
help: The Organization element needs to contain the element <md:OrganizationURL xml:lang="en">. Other languages are optional.

label: ContactPerson (technical)
help: At least one Contact with contactType 'technical' is required

label: ContactPerson (support)
help: At least one Contact with contactType 'support' is required

label: ContactPerson surname and email address
help: <md:SurName> and an <md:EMailAddress> elements are required for each ContactPerson

label: Contact person email address
help: Contact email addresses must be a valid mailto: uri.
